name: GP Brookneal OSB Plant - Brookneal VA

fieldNotes.location: Roster coords pointed at downtown Brookneal town center (wrong). Actual GP Brookneal OSB mill is at 11795 Brookneal Hwy (Hwy 501S), Gladys VA 24554 — confirmed via Forest Products Locator and multiple business listings; precise rooftop center ~37.1232,-79.0320.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Street View along the plant access road shows a divided entrance with a structure, flags and signage ~150m in from the road bend — a controlled mill entrance typical of OSB plants.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A small booth-footprint structure is visible beside the divided entrance lanes in Street View; consistent with a staffed guard booth at a wood-products mill.
fieldNotes.scale: OSB mills weigh inbound logging trucks; a truck scale near the log-yard entrance is highly likely but not crisply resolved in imagery — medium confidence.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: The entrance road has a center median splitting inbound and outbound lanes at the gate.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Limited true dock doors; OSB ships mostly on flatbeds forklift-loaded from the finished-goods warehouse. Estimated 0-10 doors on the warehouse SW/S face.
fieldNotes.dropYard: No marked trailer drop lot visible; product is staged as banded OSB units in paved yards, not parked trailers.
fieldNotes.railServed: Active rail spur with a road-crossing gate confirmed in Street View at the access road; spur runs into the property log-handling area.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Rural Campbell County VA, plant set in heavily wooded terrain well away from any town — cellular coverage likely marginal.
